name: George W. Towers
bio: George W. Towers was a stockman who took part in the round-up meeting of April 1884 and at the association's meeting in April 1885 was named to a committee to see that a stock inspector was appointed for Medora. In March 1886 he was named to a committee at the Mingusville stockmen's meeting.

moments.label: Named to committee at the Mingusville meeting

mentions: Mr. Towers left for his home ranch yesterday.
